title: Keeper of the List
bio: Owns the corner sari-sari store, and the barangay's debts. Whatever you owe goes straight into the ledger.

player_low_cards: Only a few cards left. Should I log your win in the ledger?
You're getting close. Your tab is closer.
Quick, ha. You sell out faster than loose candy.
self_low_cards: Almost out, like my last few sticks on the shelf.
Almost done here. Settle up before the store closes.
One card, then my books are balanced.
self_winning_soon: Just one! Closing time, no more sales.
A win. I'll write this in the records, with a date.
One card left, then you pay up.
got_ipit: Hey! You blocked me like a coin that came up short!
Oh, really? You're in the ledger now. You owe me one.
Hoy. No discounts for moves like that, kid.
table_cleared: Table's clean. Like a fresh noodle delivery.
New stock, new page in the ledger.
played_big_combo: Five cards. Suki discount on this one!
Five. I'm logging that as a premium item.
